facts.text: Flik, I saved you a seed from the harvest dinner. Eat it quick before the grasshoppers come round asking for more.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Dot never says this and there is no harvest dinner in the film. The Dot and Flik moments on TV Tropes have different lines, and the Moviemistakes quote page has none from Dot at all.
facts.fix: Flik, I saved you a seed from the harvest. Eat it quick before the grasshoppers come round asking for more.

fix_note.text: Flik, I saved you a seed from the harvest. Eat it quick before the grasshoppers come round asking for more.

facts.text: Dot's just a seed. Give it time.
facts.why: Flik tells Dot a little rock can stand in for a seed, and that everything a tree needs is already in a tiny seed given time. The menu line paraphrases that scene.

vibe.verdict: Colourful circus kiosk with the right cast, but the notes stay on the surface and the signed line is made up.
